study: MNIST restart: sectors and learned evidence context

background: the 16-channel growth model, a DIFFERENT task
primary_sources.title: Growing Neural Cellular Automata
primary_sources.note: Not the reference for this study. Its 16-channel state and fixed Sobel perception belong to image growth, not classification.

primary_sources.role: prior art for the 'attention' control variant
primary_sources.title: Attention-based Neural Cellular Automata (ViTCA)
primary_sources.note: Our local-attention variant is an ADAPTATION, not a faithful ViTCA reproduction; its task and training differ. Phase 2 must disclose the differences.

adaptations_from_source: TensorFlow/Keras -> PyTorch. Layer shapes, activations, initializers, update rule, noise, fire rate, loss, per-tensor gradient normalization, optimizer and LR schedule are matched to the pinned notebook.

Training uses our 50k train split rather than the full 60k population, because 5k dev + 5k calibration are held out. Reported development numbers are therefore not directly comparable to the article's test-set figures.
Primary accuracy is averaged per image and then across images; the article's batch-pooled statistic is also reported as pooled_cell_accuracy.
Target 'label pictures' are kept in broadcastable (B,10,1,1) form instead of materialised at (B,28,28,10). Numerically identical.
